answer: A pigment-batch spot audit blocks bulk fakes: a 70-credit bond buys one pigment batch in a public atlas, bound to its key. Each epoch a lottery names a shale stratum; drawn agents file pigment-stamped assays of it. A batch under two identities, or a mismatch, burns both bonds. First batch 38, k-th 38+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes spend 4,034,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented pigment fails; an honest agent pays 38 once, keeps its bond.
